context.body: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

observations.body: The thirsty are invited without price, hear a call to listen and live, receive language of everlasting covenant and David’s sure mercies, and are summoned into a widening relation with nations.
observations.label: An everlasting covenant recalls mercies to David: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps the thirsty, listeners, David, a witness, nations, and the LORD, waters, marketplace, covenant, and nations, coming, buying without money, listening, covenanting, witnessing, calling, and running visible within David's story or later memory.

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 55:1–5 as its own royal, poetic, and prophetic memory David setting before carrying its language into another source.
